=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:52-70 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The shim resolves render_prompt.py from an attacker-controlled prompt-file-relative path before trusted locations, allowing an arbitrary script to be executed.
  WHY: A malicious PROMPT_FILE such as `/tmp/evil/prompts/x.txt` can make the shim run `/tmp/evil/scripts/render_prompt.py` before falling back to trusted candidates; reviewers described this as a code-execution risk.
- scripts/render_prompt.py:447-468 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: render_prompt_text only replaces whole-line placeholders, so inline placeholders validated by collect_placeholders remain in the rendered output.
  WHY: Inline placeholders like `Text {{VAR}}` or `attempt {{PREVIOUS_ATTEMPT_NUMBER}} of {{MAX_ATTEMPTS}}` pass contract validation but are never substituted, leaving raw markers in prompts.
- scripts/render_prompt.py:357-382 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: _coerce_optional_vars rejects non-string YAML scalar defaults when PyYAML is installed, causing valid contracts to fail to load.
  WHY: Unquoted YAML values such as `true` or `123` become bool/int/float objects under PyYAML, but the function only accepts None or str, creating environment-dependent ContractLoadError failures.
- scripts/render_prompt.py:184-215 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: discover_contract_path can fall through without surfacing a missing expected contract, leaving rendering in silent no-contract mode.
  WHY: A typo in mode_name or a missing contract file can bypass validation instead of failing fast, allowing forbidden or unknown variables to slip through.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:60-66 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The shim resolves render_prompt.py from an attacker-controlled prompt path when the prompt file is in a directory named "prompts", which can cause an arbitrary script to run before trusted locations are checked.
  WHY: If PROMPT_FILE is set to `/tmp/evil/prompts/x.txt`, the code derives `prompt_root=/tmp/evil` and adds `${prompt_root}/scripts/render_prompt.py` as the first candidate.
- scripts/render_prompt.py:454-466 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: render_prompt_text only substitutes placeholders that occupy an entire line, but collect_placeholders matches placeholders anywhere in the template.
  WHY: Inline placeholders like `Text {{VAR}}` pass contract validation but are never rendered, leaving literal `{{VAR}}` in the output and corrupting prompts.
- scripts/render_prompt.py:375-381 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: When PyYAML is installed, unquoted YAML values like `true`, `false`, or `123` are parsed as non-string types, but _coerce_optional_vars only handles None and str.
  WHY: The same contract file succeeds without PyYAML but fails with ContractLoadError when PyYAML is present, creating environment-dependent behavior.
- scripts/render_prompt.py:184-215 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Contract discovery falls through candidate paths without a clear failure when an expected contract file is missing or mode_name is mistyped.
  WHY: The function silently returns None instead of failing fast, allowing prompts to render without intended validation.
- requirement: "A focused renderer test covers both a passing render and a contract violation."
  expected_change_site: CI workflow files (ci.yml, mark-stable.yml, test-and-mark-stable.yml)
  evidence of absence: The test file tests/test_render_prompt_foundation.py exists but is not included in the explicit python3 tests/ allowlist in any CI workflow. Running `grep -n "test_render_prompt" .github/workflows/*.yml` returns no matches.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- requirement: "Rendering is no longer limited to the current small placeholder set."
  expected_change_site: scripts/render_prompt.py - render_prompt_text function
  evidence of absence: The render_prompt_text function at lines 454-466 only substitutes standalone (whole-line) placeholders via STANDALONE_PLACEHOLDER_PATTERN. Inline placeholders like `{{VAR}}` embedded within text lines are never replaced, leaving them unresolved in the rendered output.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:62-70 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The shim resolves render_prompt.py from a prompt-file-relative path before checking trusted locations, which can cause execution of an arbitrary script.
  WHY: An attacker could pass an absolute path like `/tmp/evil/prompts/x.txt`, causing the shim to execute `/tmp/evil/scripts/render_prompt.py` before trusted candidates such as `${SCRIPT_DIR}/render_prompt.py`.
- scripts/render_prompt.py:447-468 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The function only replaces placeholders that occupy an entire line, but `collect_placeholders` matches any placeholder anywhere in the template.
  WHY: Inline placeholders like `attempt {{PREVIOUS_ATTEMPT_NUMBER}} of {{MAX_ATTEMPTS}}` pass contract validation but are never rendered, leaving raw `{{VAR}}` markers in the output.
- scripts/render_prompt.py:357-382 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: When PyYAML is installed, unquoted numbers and booleans in YAML contracts are parsed as Python `int`, `float`, or `bool` types, but `_coerce_optional_vars` only handles `None` and `str`.
  WHY: The same contract file loads successfully without PyYAML but raises `ContractLoadError` with PyYAML installed, causing non-deterministic failures across environments.
- requirement: "A focused renderer test covers both a passing render and a contract violation."
  expected_change_site: CI workflow files (.github/workflows/ci.yml, mark-stable.yml, test-and-mark-stable.yml)
  evidence of absence: The test file `tests/test_render_prompt_foundation.py` exists but is not listed in the explicit `python3 tests/` allowlist in any CI workflow. The repo uses explicit allowlists for test execution rather than auto-discovery, so this test will not run in CI without being added.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_20 ===
- scripts/render_prompt.py:454-468 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Only standalone (whole-line) placeholders matching STANDALONE_PLACEHOLDER_PATTERN are replaced, so inline placeholders matched by PLACEHOLDER_PATTERN are left as literal `{{VAR}}`.
  WHY: Prompts containing inline vars render with unresolved markers despite passing contract validation, which breaks the acceptance criterion for broader rendering support.
- scripts/render_prompt.py:_coerce_optional_vars() ~lines 357-382 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `_coerce_optional_vars()` accepts only None or str for optional_vars defaults when PyYAML parses YAML; non-str scalars hit the else clause and raise ContractLoadError.
  WHY: The same contract loads in the minimal parser but fails with PyYAML installed, creating environment-dependent breakage for future contracts.
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:resolve_render_prompt_py() lines ~52-70 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When prompt parent dir basename == "prompts", the first candidate is prompt_root/scripts/render_prompt.py derived from the untrusted PROMPT_FILE path before trusted paths.
  WHY: A malicious absolute PROMPT_FILE=/tmp/evil/prompts/x.txt can cause execution of attacker-controlled render_prompt.py, creating a code-execution risk in the workflow shim.
- scripts/render_prompt.py:discover_contract_path() + main() | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The code falls back silently to no-contract mode if contract_path is None, with no warning in output or stderr for expected mode contracts.
  WHY: A typo in mode_name or a missing contract bypasses validation instead of failing fast, which violates the intent of strict contracts.
- requirement: Rendering is no longer limited to the current small placeholder set. Missing/unknown/forbidden variables can be enforced through the new contract path.
  expected_change_site: scripts/render_prompt.py:render_prompt_text (must handle both standalone and inline via PLACEHOLDER_PATTERN.sub after standalone check)
  evidence of absence: LAST RUN DIFF and PR DIFF show only standalone-only logic (lines 454-468); inline test case absent; consensus from 4 reviewers + test failure would expose this.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- requirement: A focused renderer test covers both a passing render and a contract violation.
  expected_change_site: CI workflows (.github/workflows/ci.yml, mark-stable.yml, test-and-mark-stable.yml) + tests/test_render_prompt_foundation.py wiring.
  evidence of absence: Test exists and was added (good) but grep confirms no explicit `python3 tests/test_render_prompt_foundation.py` call in any workflow allowlist; test never runs in CI (pytest module also missing in runner).
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_20 ===
